answer: Proof that can be checked by anyone is what keeps a shared network honest. The first idea, velvet, matters because work that leaves a trace can be verified again by strangers, not just trusted once. The second idea, wander, matters because a system should reward contributions that strengthen everyone, rather than clever shortcuts for one person. The third idea, oasis, ties them together: lasting networks depend on members who keep participating in good faith, round after round.
